spots.line: Skeps in a row, all of them working, all of them loud.
Apple trees in lines older than the lines of the fields around them.
Jars on a shelf in the sun, and the light comes through them amber.
Windfalls left where they dropped, on purpose, for the wasps to have instead.

chests.line: A press-house crock, waxed shut, and the wax has somebody's thumbprint in it.

people.name: Hanna of the Skeps
chatter: Walk slow past the skeps and they will not mind you at all.
Forty years of trees and I planted four of them. The rest are borrowed.
I trade honey for news. You look like you have some.
Take an apple. Take two. Do not take the ones on the ground.

people.name: Piotr, who is asleep
chatter: He is under a tree with his hat over his face and he is not moving.
He says something about the cider and goes back under the hat.
